basis_claims.statement: Henwen (Old White) is a sow of Welsh legend who per the Welsh Triads bore Cath Palug, fought by Cai (Sir Kay) or King Arthur.
basis_claims.statement_id: Henwen (Old White, Si Tua Putih) babi betina legenda Wales (Welsh), menurut Welsh Triads ibu Cath Palug yang dilawan Cai (Sir Kay) atau Raja Arthur (King Arthur); di Britania Raya.
basis_claims.quote: Henwen, meaning "Old White", is in Welsh legend a sow (female pig) which according to the Welsh Triads gave birth to Cath Palug, a monstrous cat depicted as combating with either Cai (Sir Kay) or King Arthur of Arthurian Legends.

basis_claims.statement: Her birthing boded ill for the Isle of Britain; chased into the sea at Penrhyn Awstin, she re-emerged at Aber Tarogi, Gwent Is-coed.
basis_claims.statement_id: Kelahirannya pertanda buruk bagi Pulau Britania (Isle of Britain); dikejar ke laut di Penrhyn Awstin, muncul di Aber Tarogi, Gwent Is-coed.
basis_claims.quote: The sow was ready to give birth, but this boded ill for the Isle of Britain, according to prophecy, so she was chased until she plunged into the sea at Penrhyn Awstin in Cornwall. The sow eventually re-emerges on land at Aber Tarogi in Gwent Is-coed (a subdivision of Gwent).
